definitions.gloss: complete recovery; full healing (from injury or illness)
definitions.explanation: Full healing of an injury or illness to the point of complete cure. Most often stated as a length of time, as in {全治|ぜんち}{二週間|にしゅうかん} ("two weeks to fully heal"). Takes する.

examples.japanese: {全治|ぜんち}{一|いっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an injury that will take a month to fully heal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{全治|ぜんち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I broke a bone, and apparently it will take three months to heal completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全治|ぜんち}{二週間|にしゅうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捻挫|ねんざ}→捻挫：05016_nenza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠場|けつじょう}→欠場：18521_ketsujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The player has a sprain needing two weeks to heal and will sit out the next game.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (complete) + {治|ち} (cure). Typically paired with a time estimate to express how long full recovery will take.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全治|ぜんち}{二週間|にしゅうかん}: two weeks to fully recover
- {全治|ぜんち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to heal completely
- {全治|ぜんち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to take (a period) until full recovery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完治|かんじ}: complete cure — emphasizes the cured state itself; {全治|ぜんち} is more often used with a time estimate
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment — the process of treating, not the recovery

forms.negative: 全治していませんでした
